fact: Morocco's Ministry of Digital Transition and Administrative Reform announced the launch of a new version of the national Idarati portal, centred on Idarati e-Services as a unified access point to administrations' digital services.
The ministry says the Idarati portal gives access to 874 online services, organised around priority user journeys, and 2,533 published administrative acts.
We Are Tech Africa reports that authorities had placed 600 public services online in 2024, including 300 for citizens, 200 for businesses and 100 for public administrations.
The US Country Commercial Guide says Morocco has 300+ citizen and 200+ business digital services.
source_slug: 2025-07-31 Morocco Digital Economy — US Country Commercial Guide (Digital Morocco 2030)

fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform launched the new version of the national portal of administrative procedures Idarati on 18 September 2026, per analyst Slimane El Omrani.
The relaunched Idarati portal gives access to 874 public e-services (the article elsewhere says 784), up from 605 at the end of 2023 per the Court of Audit, according to analyst Slimane El Omrani.

Morocco's education ministry says it has digitised several services for baccalaureate candidates, including checking personal data, applying for a post-bac grant, getting results, filing complaints and a digital diploma.
